newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-STOICHKOV NAMED FOR BULGARIA'S FRIENDLIES IN ASIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STOICHKOV NAMED FOR BULGARIA'S FRIENDLIES IN ASIA.

text.p: Striker Hristo Stoichkov was named on Monday in Bulgaria's squad for two friendlies ahead of a World Cup qualifier against Cyprus despite saying he would not play for the national side.
Bulgaria will play Saudi Arabia on November 6 and Thailand on November 8. They face Cyprus on December 15.
Stoichkov, who plays for Barcelona, missed Bulgaria's first two World Cup European group five qualifiers after he vowed to quit the national team unless the country's soccer chiefs resigned.
Bulgaria lost 2-1 to Israel and managed only a meagre 2-1 win over Luxembourg in a disappointing opening to their World Cup campaign.
Foreign-based players in the squad for the friendlies include Krasimir Balakov of Germany's VfB Stuttgart, Yordan Lechkov of France's Marseille and Trifon Ivanov of Austria's Rapid Vienna.
